name: meyden
description: meyden marketplace for internal claude code plugins.

plugins.name: agent-toolkit
plugins.description: Writing and testing Claude Code Extensions such as Skills, Plugins, Agents and Mods.

plugins.name: remote-ssh
plugins.description: Remote work over SSH with a host pinned per Claude session: bounded logs, service restarts, deploys, and a guard hook against hanging or misdirected remote commands

plugins.name: github-flow
plugins.description: GitHub issue, PR and CI workflow enforcement via gh: issue lifecycle labels, PR conventions, CI triage, and a guard hook against auto-closing PR text

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Engineering workflow skills for senior engineers: an onboarding preflight, structured planning interviews, specs, tracer-bullet tickets, TDD implementation, and code review, wired to GitHub

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: Shows plan rate limits (5h, 7d), context fill, model and session age in a band above the prompt, plus a /usage-demo pane that tries out what mods can do

plugins.name: video-engineer
plugins.description: Turns screenshots and a sentence of direction into a finished Remotion video (interview, brief, script, images through the fal MCP, voice, music and sound effects through the fal or ElevenLabs MCP, build, critic-gated QA, incremental render, platform cuts), shows a running app in showcase and tutorial videos, and turns a song plus its lyrics into a lyric music video

plugins.name: vinted-seller
plugins.description: Turns item photos into German Vinted listings, prices them against comparable listings on vinted.de, and fills the upload form in the browser for you to publish

plugins.name: threejs-knowledge
plugins.description: Current three.js knowledge (r186, WebGL and WebGPU with TSL, React Three Fiber, physics, XR, audio, world and asset generation), five specialist agents, a hook that flags outdated three.js API, live frame stats and a visual check loop, so Claude builds, debugs and optimizes 3D scenes without being told which skill to use
